events.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 released
events.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.6 on February 5, 2026 — stronger agentic coding, 1M-token context, and state-of-the-art terminal and knowledge-work benchmarks.
events.about: Opus 4.6 added adaptive thinking, agent teams in Claude Code, and Excel and PowerPoint integrations for knowledge work. It led Terminal-Bench 2.0 and Humanity's Last Exam — Anthropic's answer to GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3 Pro in the agentic coding arms race.

narrative.whyChosen: Opus 4.6 made million-token agentic coding a production Anthropic tier.
narrative.whyImportant: Parallel agent teams and adaptive thinking pushed multi-hour autonomous work mainstream.
narrative.problemSolved: Enterprise coding agents needed better long-context retrieval and sustained focus on large codebases.
